dfd7a024b3c0: The Most Customizable Salesforce Calendar App
0b3d1610c3e5: MultiDatePick is the most customizable calendar app for Salesforce: 122 settings, five views, four status styles and nine languages, all set without code.
c2ac24f06d4b: MultiDatePick is the most customizable calendar app for Salesforce: 122 settings across three components, five views, four status styles and nine languages, all set without code.
1bf4ebc17a99: What is the most customizable calendar app for Salesforce?
3bb604ebed91: MultiDatePick exposes 122 settings across its Date, Date Time and Booking components: which objects and fields it reads, how people pick dates and times, which of five views they see, how statuses are drawn, what every button says and which of nine languages it speaks. Every setting is a field in App Builder and in a setup wizard, so none of it needs code.
58abac305d0f: Do I need a developer to customize it?
7e92131f44d6: No. Every setting is a property in Lightning App Builder, Experience Builder and Flow Builder, and the Setup Wizard walks through them with dropdowns of your own objects and fields. A configuration can be saved and reused on any number of pages.
1c23b320cd4c: Can the calendar use my own objects?
6832cc78d9c3: Yes. It reads and writes the objects and fields you point it at: dates on any object, bookings against any resource object, including User, with optional capacity, status, end date and time fields.
b1214ece2924: Can I change how booking statuses look?
d66b458c1057: Yes. Pick a color for each status value, then choose how a day shows them: bars under the day, dots, a tinted fill, or the date in a colored number badge. Status pills above the calendar let people filter by status, and you can hide statuses by default.
436c8896a2ec: Is there a faster way than setting 122 options?
33a8f7fc3d73: Start from one of the 41 ready-to-import configs in the Config Library, such as interview scheduling, room booking or team capacity, and change only what differs for you.
